description: This file implements a local cache layer for channel store operations in Mattermost, including cache invalidation, retrieval, and update of channel data and related counts.

classes.name: LocalCacheChannelStore
classes.description: A cache layer for channel store operations, managing cache invalidation, retrieval, and updates for channel data and counts.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateChannelMemberCounts
methods.description: Handles invalidation of channel member counts cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateChannelPinnedPostCount
methods.description: Handles invalidation of pinned post count cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateChannelGuestCounts
methods.description: Handles invalidation of guest count cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateChannelById
methods.description: Handles invalidation of channel by ID cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateChannelForUser
methods.description: Handles invalidation of channel for user cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateChannelMembersNotifyProps
methods.description: Handles invalidation of channel members notify props cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateChannelByName
methods.description: Handles invalidation of channel by name cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: ClearMembersForUserCache
methods.description: Clears the cache for all channel memberships for a specific user.

methods.name: ClearCaches
methods.description: Clears all relevant channel caches and updates cache invalidation metrics.

methods.name: InvalidatePinnedPostCount
methods.description: Invalidates the pinned post count cache for a specific channel.

methods.name: InvalidateMemberCount
methods.description: Invalidates the member count cache for a specific channel.

methods.name: InvalidateGuestCount
methods.description: Invalidates the guest count cache for a specific channel.

methods.name: InvalidateChannel
methods.description: Invalidates the cache for a specific channel by ID.

methods.name: InvalidateAllChannelMembersForUser
methods.description: Invalidates all cached channel memberships for a user, including deleted memberships.

methods.name: InvalidateCacheForChannelMembersNotifyProps
methods.description: Invalidates the cache for channel members' notify props for a specific channel.

methods.name: InvalidateChannelByName
methods.description: Invalidates the cache for a channel identified by team ID and name.

methods.name: GetMemberCount
methods.description: Retrieves the member count for a channel, using cache if allowed.

methods.name: GetGuestCount
methods.description: Retrieves the guest count for a channel, using cache if allowed.

methods.name: GetMemberCountFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves the member count for a channel directly from cache.

methods.name: GetPinnedPostCount
methods.description: Retrieves the pinned post count for a channel, using cache if allowed.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a channel by ID, using cache if allowed.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves multiple channels by IDs, utilizing cache when possible.

methods.name: GetAllChannelMembersForUser
methods.description: Gets all channel memberships for a user, with optional cache usage.

methods.name: GetAllChannelMembersNotifyPropsForChannel
methods.description: Gets all notify props for channel members, with optional cache usage.

methods.name: GetByNamesIncludeDeleted
methods.description: Retrieves channels by names including deleted ones, with cache support.

methods.name: GetByNames
methods.description: Retrieves channels by names, excluding deleted ones, with cache support.

methods.name: GetByNameIncludeDeleted
methods.description: Retrieves a channel by team ID and name, including deleted, with cache support.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Retrieves a channel by team ID and name, excluding deleted, with cache support.

methods.name: SaveMember
methods.description: Saves a channel member and updates member count cache if using Redis.

methods.name: SaveMultipleMembers
methods.description: Saves multiple channel members and updates member count cache accordingly.

methods.name: GetChannelsMemberCount
methods.description: Gets member counts for multiple channels, utilizing cache when possible.

methods.name: UpdateMember
methods.description: Updates a channel member and invalidates member count cache.

methods.name: UpdateMultipleMembers
methods.description: Updates multiple channel members and invalidates cache for each.

methods.name: RemoveMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a channel and updates cache accordingly.

methods.name: RemoveMembers
methods.description: Removes multiple members from a channel and updates cache accordingly.
